He's unstoppable.|Daakman Barrek requests assistance from Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=New-droid-general.flac|{{CW|20}}}} '''Hypori''' {{Pronounced|haɪ'poɹi}} was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hypori system/Legends|Hypori system]] of the [[Ferra sector/Legends|Ferra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to no [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], though it was host to [[windrail]]s and [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]]. Its surface was covered in rocky landscapes and small [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Battle above Hypori|battle]] took place over the planet. In [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] spent a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] on Hypori with no [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] or [[Water/Legends|water]] under command from his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Left to face a horde of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], Maul survived, dueling his master at the end and losing. He gained the admiration of Sidious, however, and was given the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Hypori was transformed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] world by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], with its purpose being to manufacture [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for the upcoming [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the onset of the Clone Wars, the planet was the site of the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], during which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Daakman Barrek]], [[Sha'a Gi]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[K'Kruhk]], [[Tarr Seirr]], and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] fought against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and a large army of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was defeated, and only four of the Jedi survived, rescued by [[The Muunilinst 10]] in their [[Muunilinst 10 LAAT|Republic gunship]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Hypori came under the control of [[Tyber Zann]] and the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] after the criminal empire took it from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. ==Description== [[File:Hypori-barren-wasteland.png|thumb|left|250px|Hypori's rocky surface]] Hypori was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ferra sector/Legends|Ferra sector's]] [[Hypori system/Legends|Hypori system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and it shared a name with the [[Hypori (star)|star]] it orbited. It was a temperate world of small [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and rocky landscapes rich with minerals, and it had a diameter of 13,330 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. Its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was breathable. Though the planet was not the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of any [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], it was home to non-sentient [[windrail]]s and [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]]. ==History== ===Test flight=== [[File:Battle_above_Hypori.png|thumb|right|250px|The battle during the Galactic War]] During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Hypori was the site of a [[Battle above Hypori|battle]] that took place in [[3639 BBY]].{{TOR_updates|1.6}} The Empire deployed a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] and a complement of several [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transports]], three [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors]], and scores of [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]] to attack the Republic's prototype [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], the [[Gilded Meteor]], on its maiden voyage in the Ferra sector. In response, the Republic fleet requested reinforcements over Hypori to escort the bomber to safety and provide support for its handful of [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] there to repel the assailant Imperial forces. The Republic's [[Coruscant Aegis]] covert operations [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]{{TORcite|type=space|Fondor Escort}} responded to the call for help, and backup arrived over Hypori in the form of a lone ship operated by a Republic-aligned hero. Nevertheless, it successfully escorted the Gilded Meteor and destroyed much of the Sith Empire's forces, crippling the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnought]] with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] before leaving Hypori along with the Republic [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. ===Training ground=== In the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the Republic, Hypori belonged to the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. Its [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], agreed to supply the planet as a training ground for [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and its [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Sun Guard]], providing the necessary [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], in exchange for Tambor's seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] [[Sith training|trained]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] on Hypori with [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. In [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]], during [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] training under the command of Darth Sidious, the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] spent a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] on the planet without [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] or [[Water/Legends|water]] and with a horde of assassin droids as his opponents. Sidious returned to fight against Maul, easily besting his exhausted, injured apprentice and depriving him of [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]]. Enraged, Maul continued to attack Sidious with his fists and teeth. Pleased, Sidious appraised him for passing the final test, and Maul was given the title of Sith Lord, secretly against Darth Plagueis' wishes. ===Clone Wars=== [[File:Hypori_droids.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] on the surface of Hypori]] Following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Hypori and the nearby planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] were transformed into secret [[Factory world/Legends|foundry worlds]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], in order to bypass the Republic's new laws strictly regulating the manufacture and distribution of battle droids. The [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], a subsidiary of the Trade Federation,''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' took ownership of Hypori, with the intention of constructing and maintaining the new [[Droid factory|droid factories]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The planet appealed to Baktoid due to its abundance of natural minerals and [[Ore/Legends|ore]], which they planned to use as a source of raw materials for its factories. In addition, Hypori's lack of sentient inhabitants made it much easier for Baktoid to take ownership of the world. As part of their colonization efforts, Baktoid relocated an entire hive of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] workers to Hypori. The Geonosians found that the planet's tough bedrock and soil proved difficult to assimilate into a proper hive-mound, but their workers eventually converted much of the planet into a series of huge underground foundries. The existence of these [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factories was kept secret from the Republic during the lead-up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Daakman Barrek]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Sha'a Gi]], uncovered the Separatist operations on Hypori during an intelligence-gathering mission in the sector. They reported back to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which dispatched an elite [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] strike team to investigate further. [[File:Aayla_and_Ki-Adi_vs._Grievous.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi battling Grievous]] Unfortunately for the Republic forces, the Separatists had not left Hypori defenseless, and had disguised [[Space mine/Legends|mines]] seeded in the planet's orbit which crippled much of the [[Task force/Legends|task force]]. With much of the Republic forces destroyed before reaching the surface of Hypori, surviving Jedi—among them [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[K'Kruhk]], [[Tarr Seirr]], [[Sha'a Gi]], and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]—were [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|ambushed]] by [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] led by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] cyborg [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]],{{CW|21}} marking his debut as [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]{{CSWECite|I|369|Grievous, General}} to the Jedi{{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} in what became known as the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]]. The ruined hulk of an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that had crashed into Hypori's surface became the site of an epic battle between the cyborg and the Jedi. During the battle, Tarr Seirr and Sha'a Gi were killed, and two others were severely wounded. The four surviving Jedi managed to escape with the help of the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] unit [[the Muunilinst 10]], led by task force commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]]. Having achieved his mission objective though sheer firepower on Hypori, Fordo was awarded the [[Chancellor's Service Medal]], although the clone captain transferred it to [[CT-43/002]], who died a hero at the previous [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].{{CSWECite|I|288|Fordo}} The events on Hypori echoed around the surrounding region, the planet's name being one of several that the young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on the nearby world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], came to associate with the Clone Wars [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the conflict's end''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' Though some of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were destroyed during the rescue attempt, the droid factories on Hypori remained in operation during the war. At least one remained operational after the end of the Clone Wars, after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|ordered]] the deactivation of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist droid armies]] from [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in 19 BBY.{{Film|III}} ===The Zann Consortium=== {{Quote|According to data we recovered on Saleucami, Jabba's stumbled across an old battle droid factory on Hypori that somehow survived the Clone Wars.''"
"''The factory is still functional?''"
"''My sources believe it is. Jabba has been unable to get the factory operational. I want control of it so I can begin manufacturing an invasion army of my own.|Tyber Zann, to Urai Fen|}} During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Tyber Zann]], [[Crime lord/Legends|leader]] of the criminal empire known as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], was lured by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to Hypori. Jabba hoped that Zann would destroy the [[droideka Mark II]]s in a [[Hypori droid factory|droid factory]] that had been constructed by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] during the Clone Wars, though the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was counting on Zann dying in the process, as the two were enemies. Jabba used data stored on the planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], which Zann had recently captured, to tempt Zann with the prospect of building an [[Army/Legends|army]]. In order to scope out the opportunity, Zann sent his associate, [[Urai Fen]], ahead to gather intel. [[File:Jabba-Zann-Hypori.png|thumb|left|250px|Jabba confronts Zann in the droid factory.]] After landing on the planet's surface and entering the droid foundry, Zann and Fen proceeded to the droid controls, where they deactivated the remaining [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] in the facility. They were then captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], but Zann bribed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] with triple the payment he was to receive from Jabba. The Hutt then revealed himself, and ordered his minions to kill Zann and all his forces. However, the Consortium managed to [[Ground Battle on Hypori|capture]] all landing zones and defeat Jabba's forces, and in the process, Fen reached the droid works and gain control of the facility's droidekas. After the victory over Jabba's forces, Zann agreed to a ceasefire with the Hutts so long as they lifted the bounty on his head and ceased attacking his operations and he promised to avoid interfering in Hutt affairs. Upon their agreement, Hypori came under the control of the Zann Consortium, and the criminal organization used the planet's technology to continue production of droideka Mark IIs, as well as to construct [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class gunships]] and droid works and factories on their other worlds. These new droidekas soon began to appear in the hands of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups and private armies across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''
